envelope.description: strict block-object envelope in asset space (X width, Y up, Z depth; front -Z; pivot at footprint bottom centre)

roof_platform.description: ONE flat empty platform per model. The WALKING SURFACE is the model apex at y = 1.00; nothing exists above it; the 30 cm above it is empty (stacking safe). The perimeter fascia is a flush 0.04 band whose top is the walking surface (protrusion above the top = 0.00).

uv_space.model: ART-07 world-scale planar projection (one frozen density per VANILLA MATERIAL, mapped into that material's own real 1024x1024 _D texture canvas); the ART-06 flat-patch density (32 px/grid) is retired and only kept as a legacy fallback in art/material_patches.assign_flat_patch_uvs
uv_space.mapping: uv = uv_center + (world_uv - world_center) * px_per_m / texture_size; dominant face normal picks the projection plane (+-X -> U=y,V=z; +-Y -> U=x,V=z; +-Z -> U=x,V=y) in the Blender author space (Z up, front +Y, world center [0,0,0.5])
uv_space.game_sampling: AutoAtlaser remaps uv_atlas = uv * (1/sizeMultiplier) + cell_offset and each fragment keeps its native 1024x1024 cell, so a UV component > 1 would sample another material; ART-07 therefore keeps every UV inside the material canvas (no UV>1 Repeat tiling) and uses the maximum legal native-on-atlas density

uv_mapping.wrap_evidence: Texture2D.m_WrapMode = 0 (Repeat), m_FilterMode = 2 (Trilinear), m_Aniso = 16 in resources.assets; Repeat is real but never reached in game because AutoAtlaser remaps the mesh UV into the material's atlas cell (see art/ART07_UV_TILING.md section 1)

thresholds.std_definition: max over R,G,B of the population std of the patch pixels (raw sRGB 0..255 bytes) - recomputed by art/png_stats.py

large_shell_policy.reason: their entire albedo is warning-stripe paint; any large face would read as a hazard sign (user bug 2026-10-27). They stay in MATERIAL_WHITELIST for completeness but must never appear in a shipped model.

construction_metal.reason: ART-07 shared construction-stage UV window: the construction stage is one shared source mesh with ONE baked UV set (Folktails materials), so both factions' materials must resolve the same UV window; the window is the BaseMetal.Folktails ART-07 canvas and BaseMetal.IronTeeth's own canvas contains it (full-bleed tile texture).

construction_wood.reason: ART-07 shared construction-stage UV window: the construction stage is one shared source mesh with ONE baked UV set (Folktails materials), so both factions' materials must resolve the same UV window; the window is the BaseWood_Brown.Folktails ART-07 canvas and RoofPlanks.IronTeeth's own canvas contains it (full-bleed tile texture).
